name: Vertebrate Genomes Project assemblies
blurb: Reference-quality vertebrate genome assemblies produced by the Vertebrate Genomes Project and affiliated efforts, as listed by the UCSC VGP assembly hub. Each assembly is identified here by a sequence collection digest, with any refgenie assets built for it.
note: An independent refgenie view of publicly available assemblies. Not run by the Vertebrate Genomes Project.

name: Reference genome jungle
blurb: Human and mouse reference genomes collected for the reference genome jungle dataset: 60 Homo sapiens and 36 Mus musculus assemblies from UCSC, Ensembl, NCBI, GENCODE, iGenomes, refgenie and other sources. Many are near-copies of one another, so this collection shows how assemblies that share a name can differ.

name: AWS iGenomes
blurb: The AWS iGenomes reference genomes used by nf-core and Illumina pipelines: about 130 builds for 31 organisms, from Ensembl, NCBI, UCSC, GATK and Illumina. Each build is identified here by a sequence collection digest, with any refgenie assets built for it.
note: An independent refgenie view of the public iGenomes FASTA files.
